f.d: Description of the device posture check
Represents how the device posture check is rendered in device assurance policies
Display name of the device posture check
OSQuery for the device posture check

Default i18n key for the message.
Custom text for the message
Unique name of the device posture check

v.name: Device posture check macOS
v.description: Query macOS devices to check if firewall is enabled
v.query: SELECT CASE WHEN global_state = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS firewall_enabled FROM alf;

message.customText: It is our company policy that all devices must have a firewall enabled.

v.name: Device posture check Windows
v.description: Query Windows devices to check if firewall is enabled
v.query: SELECT CASE WHEN enabled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS firewall_enabled FROM windows_firewall_profiles;

message.customText: It is our company policy that all devices must have a firewall enabled.
